rows.observed: 2-Step targets 10%/5%, daily loss 5%, maximum loss 10%, minimum four trading days, no time limit; 90% reward share on the resulting FTMO Account.
2-Step daily floor is midnight CE(S)T balance minus 5% of initial capital; equity includes floating PnL, commissions and swaps. Static floor is 90% of initial capital.
Evaluation is exempt from this restriction. Funded Standard closes before weekends and market breaks longer than two hours. Instrument trading hours must be checked in MT4/MT5 specification.
Evaluation is exempt. Funded Standard affected instruments restrict opening/closing within two minutes either side of specified events; SL/TP execution also counts. Swing is exempt.
Free Trial is 14 days, with two minimum trading days and half the Challenge profit target. Passing it does not automatically qualify for an FTMO Account.
